pair.missing_credentials: Open the TTLock app settings (Apps, TTLock, Configure) and fill in the clientId and clientSecret first.

device.no_gateway: This lock has no gateway, so it cannot be controlled from Homey.
device.relogin: TTLock login expired. Use Repair on this device to log in again.

settings.intro: Create an application at open.ttlock.com (euopen.ttlock.com for Europe) and enter its client ID and secret here.
settings.poll_interval: Default poll interval (minutes, used for newly added devices)
settings.monthly_limit: Monthly API call limit (30,000 on the free TTLock plan)
settings.test_intro: Logs in with your TTLock app account and lists your locks. The values above are used (no need to save first). The password is not stored.
settings.webhook_intro: Paste this URL as the callback URL in the TTLock Management Center to get lock events in real time.
settings.webhook_missing: Not configured (add WEBHOOK_ID and WEBHOOK_SECRET to env.json)
settings.session_intro: Forgets the stored TTLock login. Use Repair on a device afterwards to log in again.
settings.session_cleared: Session cleared. Use Repair on a device to log in again.
